title: A New Library
text:
Last month, the mayor of a small town gave a speech in the town square. She spoke about the new library that would open next year. She explained that the library would have free computers and a quiet room for students. Many people in the crowd clapped when she finished.

After the speech, a young man named Leo asked a question about the opening hours. The mayor smiled and promised to answer him in a letter. Leo said he was excited because he had wanted a place to study for a long time.

questions.text: What did the mayor talk about?
Why did many people in the crowd clap?
options: They liked the news about the library
They were angry about the speech
They were waiting for a train

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Leo?
options: He wanted a quiet place to study
He wanted to move to another town

vocabulary.definition: a formal talk given to an audience
a place where people borrow books and study
a large group of people gathered together
said that you will definitely do something

paragraph_translations: W zeszłym miesiącu pani burmistrz wygłosiła przemówienie na rynku w małym miasteczku. Mówiła o nowej bibliotece, która miała się otworzyć w przyszłym roku. Wyjaśniła, że biblioteka będzie miała darmowe komputery i cichy pokój dla uczniów. Wiele osób w tłumie klaskało, gdy skończyła.

Po przemówieniu młody mężczyzna o imieniu Leo zapytał o godziny otwarcia. Pani burmistrz uśmiechnęła się i obiecała odpowiedzieć mu w liście. Leo powiedział, że się cieszy, ponieważ od dawna chciał mieć miejsce do nauki.
